ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio with approximately 75% high-intensity white pixels and 25% low-intensity black pixels on the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions covering the majority of both lobes. Low-intensity black pigmentation concentrated along the trailing edges and in an irregular, roughly triangular zone radiating from the median notch base into the lower quadrants of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 45 degrees and significant depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration pattern characterized by numerous sharp peaks and valleys (3-8 pixel amplitude) along the continuous trailing boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strong convex curve originating from the fluke tips and sweeping inward towards the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of high-contrast, roughly circular white pixel groups (barnacles) located along the outer leading and distal edges of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned dark linear pixel disruptions (approx. 3-5 distinct lines) visible across the white pigment on the viewer's left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustation along distal edges; irregular, jagged indentation on the outer trailing edge of the left lobe suggesting minor past trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced asymmetrical black pigmentation at the notch base, with more extensive intrusion into the right lobe compared to the left.
